title: The 2015 Nobel citation credits Tu Youyou with a malaria therapy
summary: The Nobel Foundation credits Tu Youyou for discoveries concerning a novel therapy against malaria. The same year's other citation is a therapy against roundworm.
body: The Nobel Prize API record for 2015 gives Tu Youyou a motivation for her discoveries concerning a novel therapy against malaria. The same record gives William C. Campbell and Satoshi Ōmura a different motivation, for discoveries concerning a novel therapy against infections caused by roundworm parasites. The record dates the award 5 October 2015. Current malaria case estimates are on the WHO card. This card separates the two 2015 motivations and does not name a chemical the motivation sentence does not name.

sources.title: The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 2015

sources.note: Motivation text was read from the Nobel Prize API record.
